author: Sneha Adhikari
review_text: I'd say go for other alternatives because clearly any online payment service provider would be more inclined towards customer service as compared to eSewa. I raised an issue regarding my transaction error 12 days ago and it still hasn't been solved neither have they given me any updates about it. I've tried contacting them everyway possible; customer service number, email, Grievance Officer, Instagram, you name it! But still there's no response. Bunch of Irresponsible people!
